description: Place a material on the canvas as new source layers: an item as one layer, a folder as one layer per item in it with its subfolders as source groups, items keeping their places relative to each other. Default size: the item's own place (a PSD layer's position) with the PSD's canvas centred on the project canvas and shrunk to fit it (unchanged when both are one size), else one material pixel per canvas unit fitted into the canvas. Canvas units are the model's coordinates (exported as the Cubism model canvas, one pixel per unit) and set its size, not its sharpness, which comes from the material's own pixels and the atlas budget; rect sets an item's canvas rectangle (the pixels are not resampled, so a smaller rectangle is a denser texture); at [x, y] centres the placement there. The material's tags and its folders' tags become the layer's tags. Placed layers paint over the others. Every placed layer immediately has an editable mesh and texture tile; semantic binding waits for rig_generate; move them with layer_set_canvas_rect or layer_transform (move, scale, mirror, rotate), replace their pixels with layer_replace_image. layer_id names a single item's new layer. reference true places every layer as a reference layer (layer_mark_reference), false as model layers; omitted, each item follows its own mark (material_mark_reference). The changed list names the new layers (layer:<id>). One history edit. Returns a process-owned job handle; use job_wait/job_get for the result.

state.description: Opaque state from workspace_inspect or the preceding result. Includes load generation and durable version; history node IDs are not state tokens.

request_id.description: Unique request ID. Retry unchanged arguments with this ID to recover the same result; use a new ID for a new attempt.

project_id.description: Current project_id from workspace_inspect; null only when no project is loaded.
